text:
The plate looks like a square side or dinner plate, roughly 22 cm across.

The food is scrambled egg whites, or possibly a soft white cooked egg, plus cubes of cantaloupe and pineapple.

Egg whites: the pile covers about half the plate and is fairly thin to moderate in depth. I estimate about 150 g. Egg white is about 52 kcal per 100 g, so that is roughly 80 kcal. If it were whole-egg scramble the figure would be higher, but this is white, so it may have been cooked with a little oil.

Fruit: about 6 cantaloupe cubes and 5 pineapple cubes. That is roughly 110 g of cantaloupe (about 35 kcal per 100 g, so 38 kcal) and 80 g of pineapple (about 50 kcal per 100 g, so 40 kcal).

Total mass is about 150 + 110 + 80 = 340 g. Total energy is about 80 + 38 + 40 = 158 kcal, which I round up to 160 to allow for a little cooking fat.
